nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Example environment file listing the two public Vite build-time variables (VITE_API_URL, VITE_UPLOAD_URL) that developers copy into a local .env to point the frontend at the backend API and upload server.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.prod
nodes.summary: Multi-stage production Docker build that compiles the Vite/React frontend in a Node 20 Alpine builder stage, then serves the static bundle from an nginx Alpine image with a healthcheck and a runtime env-injection entrypoint script for VITE_API_URL/VITE_UPLOAD_URL.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a runtime env-injection entrypoint script that writes window.ENV into env-config.js, letting the same built image be reconfigured per-deployment without a rebuild.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Node 20 Alpine build stage that installs dependencies with npm ci and runs the Vite production build using VITE_API_URL/VITE_UPLOAD_URL build args.

nodes.name: nginx
nodes.summary: Nginx Alpine runtime stage that serves the static assets produced by the builder stage on port 80, with an HTTP healthcheck and env-injection entrypoint.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.prod.truenas
nodes.summary: TrueNAS-specific production Docker build that builds the frontend with relative /api and /uploads URLs and uses an nginx config template with envsubst to inject BACKEND_HOST/BACKEND_PORT at container startup, avoiding hardcoded backend URLs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses gettext's envsubst against an nginx config template so the backend host/port can be set purely via container env vars rather than baked into the image.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.truenas
nodes.summary: Alternate TrueNAS frontend Dockerfile that builds with relative /api and /uploads URLs and copies a static TrueNAS nginx proxy config directly (no envsubst), including a wget-based healthcheck against /health.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Boilerplate Vite + React + TypeScript template README covering HMR plugin choices (Babel vs SWC) and guidance for enabling stricter, type-aware ESLint configuration.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry point for the Vite-built SPA; sets PWA meta tags and theme color, preloads Google Fonts, links the manifest and favicons, and mounts the React app via /src/main.tsx into the #root div.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the travel-life-frontend app defining dev/build/test scripts (Vite, Vitest, ESLint) and the full dependency set including React 19, TanStack Query, Zustand, Leaflet mapping, dnd-kit, and PWA tooling.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the app's src/ source code, targeting ES2022 with bundler module resolution, strict type-checking, and React JSX support.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript solution file that references the app and node tsconfig project files for composite builds.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for Node-context tooling files such as vite.config.ts, targeting ES2023 with strict checks.

nodes.name: tsconfig.prod.app.json
nodes.summary: Production variant of the app TypeScript config that extends tsconfig.app.json but relaxes strict/unused-code checks and excludes test files, used by the non-strict `build` npm script so TypeScript warnings don't block production builds.

nodes.name: tsconfig.prod.json
nodes.summary: Production TypeScript solution file referencing the relaxed prod app config and node config; keeps strict/casing checks at the root while the app config relaxes unused-code rules for production builds.
